=== FAQ ===
Heading: Foundation repair questions, answered
Intro: Straight answers about inspections, warranties, timelines, and what to expect on your property.
Q: How do I know if I need foundation repair?
A: Warning signs include drywall cracks, sticking doors, sloping floors, and gaps around windows. We confirm movement with measurements — not guesses.
Q: Do you offer warranties on foundation work?
A: Yes. We document warranty coverage in writing before work starts so you know what is protected.
